title: Product Lanes and Boundaries
summary: Accepted normative Product Architecture Ontology contract for programs, capabilities, clients, adapters, assertions, relationship vocabulary, and dependency boundaries.

triggers: ADR-057 is superseded or its accepted scope changes
the canonical ontology concepts or relationship vocabulary change
the Product Architecture Assertion schemas or dependency doctrine change
freshness.reason: Verified against accepted ADR-057, the canonical ontology, and assertion schema at the Phase 1 base.

read_when: classifying stable product programs, capabilities, clients, adapters, or source subsystems
reviewing Product Architecture Assertion or relationship semantics
checking dependency directions, projection rules, or product-lane boundaries
must_not_prove: current support, runtime participation, ownership, strategy, or integration posture
current product-architecture relationship instances or source-subsystem mappings
runtime implementation, repository restructuring, or release support

relations.authority_scope: Product Architecture Ontology vocabulary, assertions, relationships, and dependency doctrine
relations.rationale: Accepted ADR-057 establishes this Product Architecture Ontology contract and its bounded doctrine.

relations.authority_scope: Product Architecture Ontology integration with DLG identity, authority, lifecycle, evidence, and retrieval semantics
relations.rationale: Product Lanes extends the DLG and relies on it for document identity, authority, lifecycle, evidence, and retrieval semantics.
